planets.name: WASP-32 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Parumleo with a 2.72-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-32 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Parumleo. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
